275274926.description:
Velvet Pipe & Cigarette Tobacco
Empty Metal Pocket Tins Lot of 10 with Original Display Box
Vintage, 1.5 oz Size
A collection of vintage Velvet brand tobacco tins, a staple of 20th-century American tobacciana. These pocket-sized tins feature the iconic red lithographed design with a smoking pipe and cigarette illustration. Velvet was marketed as "America's Smoothest Smoke," utilizing sun-ripened Kentucky Burley tobacco. This lot is ideal for advertising collectors or period-accurate displays.
Lot includes 10 individual 1.5 oz metal pocket tins
Original cardboard shipping/display box included
Hinged lids with "Push Up" opening mechanism
Classic red, white, and green lithograph graphics
Condition:
All tins are empty. Metal surfaces show oxidation and surface rust, primarily on top rims and interiors. Lithograph graphics exhibit minor scratching and shelf wear consistent with age. The cardboard box shows significant wear, including tears, crushing, and frayed edges as visible in the images.

275393138.description:
Scotch EG T-120 VHS Tape Lot - 49 Tapes
Blank Media - VHS Format
Late 1980s/Early 1990s Era
This massive lot features 49 original Scotch EG T-120 videocassettes, a staple of the home recording era produced by 3M. Known for their "Everyday Use" reliability, these tapes were designed for recording television series, movies, and home videos with a clear signal-to-noise ratio and a lifetime warranty. Finding a bulk quantity of these classic American-made tapes in factory-sealed condition is increasingly rare for media collectors and analog enthusiasts.
49 Factory-sealed videocassettes (T-120 format)
Standard Grade for everyday recording needs
Made in the USA by 3M Consumer Video and Audio Products
Recording Time: 2 hours (SP), 4 hours (LP), 6 hours (EP/SLP)
Condition:
All 49 tapes are in New In Packaging (NIP) condition, remaining factory sealed in their original clear plastic wrap. The protective cardboard sleeves are well-preserved with sharp corners and vibrant graphics, showing only negligible signs of shelf wear from long-term storage. All units are unused and pristine.
